hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: With n up to 10^6, slice comparison O(n^2 / k) will exceed time limits.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Use the Z-algorithm to precompute z-values for string word, where z[i] is the length of the longest common prefix between word and word[i:].

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: For each step t >= 1 with t * k < n, if z[t * k] >= n - t * k, return t.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear time Z-algorithm for suffix-prefix matching.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Quadratic string comparisons time out for n = 10^6.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary array for Z-algorithm prefix lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use Z-function or KMP to query suffix-prefix equality in O(1) time.
